candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student – Master Data Management Materials & Production Master
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Master Data Management. Keeping SAP data consistent and finding out why numbers do not match is the part of my previous work I enjoyed most, and I would like to focus on it in a master data team.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau (expected graduation September 2028, so well over two semesters left) with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked with SAP data as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I used SQL analysis, ABAP CDS view validation and data reconciliation to find and fix inconsistencies behind our SAP reports
I built a quality inspection dashboard in SAP Analytics Cloud that replaced opening an SAP report per material for thousands of materials
I was one of 10 participants from Pakistan selected for the SAP Young Professionals Program, trained on S/4HANA Cloud end-to-end business processes

letter.problems_section: I would work through the data queue carefully, run cleansing checks, trace data quality issues to their root cause and write clear procedures and training notes. I have not yet worked in the PP module itself, but my S/4HANA training and certification give me a solid starting point, and I am comfortable with advanced Excel.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Berlin and can work 20 hours per week for the full contract period and beyond, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss how I can support your team.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
